name: Mobile audit of the JARVIS UI
description: Capture the JARVIS views at phone sizes (390x844, 360x740, landscape), run axe-core and measure horizontal overflow and touch targets under 44px, then return a short pass/fail summary with the output folder instead of the full log. Wraps scripts/mobile-shots.js of the RIGS checkout; needs playwright and axe-core installed in ~/.cache/rigs-audit. Starts its own server on port 4781, so it is safe to run next to production.

out.description: output folder, relative to the RIGS checkout; default docs/mobile-audit/after

url.description: audit a running JARVIS instead of starting one (never a production daemon)

strict.description: exit 1 when overflow or small touch targets are found

appDir.description: RIGS checkout holding scripts/mobile-shots.js; default RIGS_APP_DIR, then this tool's repo, then ~/.rigs/app

dryRun.description: show the command that would run

outputs: { ok, out, check: the script's CHECK line, report: { count, overflow, smallTargets, pageErrors, captureFailed, axeViolationRules, failing[{ view, viewport, overflow, smallTargets, errors, axe }] } }
